user.title: Watering Project
user.description: Discovers plant moisture sensors and exposes a per-plant status. Thresholds and device selection are configured afterwards in the integration options.

abort.already_configured: Watering Project is already set up. Use the integration options to change thresholds or select devices.

init.title: Watering Project options
init.description: Plants are grouped by room. Devices whose names look like leak or flood sensors are excluded automatically unless you list them under include devices.

data_description.moisture_default: Below this percentage a plant is reported as dry. Capacitive sensors often read around 70% on already dry soil.
data_description.battery_suspect_days: How long a battery must report 0% before the sensor is treated as untrustworthy.
data_description.include_devices: Overrides the automatic leak-sensor exclusion. Empty means all detected devices.
data_description.exclude_devices: Always ignored, wins over include devices.
data_description.notify_service: Service name without the notify. prefix, for example mobile_app_pixel.
data_description.notify_repeat_hours: 0 sends one notification per drought; the reminder repeats otherwise.
data_description.notify_url: Optional URL opened when the notification is tapped, for example /lovelace/0.

error.notify_service_required: Pick a notify service or disable notifications.
error.notify_service_not_found: That notify service is not registered in Home Assistant.

notify_service_missing.title: Notifications could not be sent
notify_service_missing.description: The notify service `{service}` is not available or failed: {detail}. Check the service name in the integration options, or disable notifications.

battery_suspect.title: Battery readings are untrustworthy
battery_suspect.description: These sensors report 0% battery for longer than the configured duration, so their plant status cannot be trusted and they are excluded from watering notifications: {plants}.
